items.title: Alex Bigard Interview, 1960-04-30
items.q: They had Willie Pajot. They had Walter Dicku, myself, and Sam Dutre, senior. ... Just four pieces, that's all we had.

ctx.x: Then sometimes we'd have old man Sam Dutre playing with us. Sam Dutre's daddy, the one that played tenor. Did he play tenor or clarinet any time too? No. No. No. No. No. No. No. No. No. No. No. No. No. No. No. No. No. No.
No. No. No. No. No. No. No. No.
